articles.title: How to send your bills to TallyPrime
articles.summary: Make TallyPrime import files from your saved Nivesh Sahayak documents: set ledger names, back up Tally, import masters first, then vouchers, check the Day Book.

articles.title: How to turn an Excel sheet into a Tally import file
articles.summary: Turn a sales or purchase register, receipts, payments or journal sheet into TallyPrime XML: every row checked, new ledgers matched to your Tally names.

articles.title: How to turn a bank statement into Tally vouchers
articles.summary: Turn a bank statement PDF, Excel or CSV into Tally Receipt, Payment and Contra vouchers: a ledger for each line, remembered per payee for next month.
